summary: Comprehensive testing of lead verification system. All 13 backend tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed. The verification flow works correctly: send verification creates record, verify endpoint updates lead status, flagged leads endpoint returns correct data.

minor.issue: Email sending returns 'warning' status in preview environment due to Resend domain verification restrictions. Verification record is still created correctly.

passed_tests: POST /api/admin/leads/{lead_id}/send-verification creates verification record and returns success/warning
POST /api/admin/leads/{lead_id}/send-verification fails if lead has no email (400)
POST /api/admin/leads/{lead_id}/send-verification fails if lead is not assigned to clinic (400)
POST /api/admin/leads/{lead_id}/send-verification fails if verification already pending (400)
GET /api/verify/{token}?response=yes returns ok and updates lead verification_status to 'verified'
GET /api/verify/{token}?response=no returns ok and updates lead verification_status to 'flagged'
GET /api/admin/verifications/flagged returns only leads with verification_status='flagged'
Frontend /verify/{token} page shows 'Грешка' for invalid token
Frontend /verify/{token}?response=yes shows success message with green checkmark
Frontend /verify/{token} without response param shows Yes/No choice buttons
Frontend Yes/No buttons are clickable and trigger API calls
Frontend shows 'already responded' message on second click
critical_code_review_comments: Verification token is generated with secrets.token_urlsafe(32) - secure
Verify endpoint is GET (not POST) for email link compatibility - correct design
Lead status updates correctly: yes->verified, no->flagged
Already responded check prevents duplicate submissions
All data-testids are properly implemented: verify-loading, verify-choose, btn-yes, btn-no, verify-success-yes, verify-success-no, verify-already, verify-error
seed_data_creation: Created test leads with email for verification testing. Test leads are cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lead verification system fully tested. Key endpoints: POST /api/admin/leads/{id}/send-verification (creates verification record), GET /api/verify/{token}?response=yes|no (public endpoint for patient response), GET /api/admin/verifications (list all), GET /api/admin/verifications/flagged (flagged leads only). Email sending via Resend is MOCKED in preview (unverified domain) but DB records are created correctly. Auto-verification background loop runs hourly for leads assigned 24h+ ago. Key data-testids: verify-loading, verify-choose, btn-yes, btn-no, verify-success-yes, verify-success-no, verify-already, verify-error.
mocked_api_note: Email sending via Resend won't deliver in preview environment (unverified domain) but the API call and DB record creation still work correctly. The endpoint returns status='warning' when email fails to send.
